caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a decorative border consisting of wavy and zigzag patterns in green, yellow, red, black, and white. Inside the border, there is a black background with a stylized bird in the center. The bird is rendered in shades of pink and white, with simplified features, a curved tail, and a small white eye. Surrounding the bird are various floral and leaf elements, including large flowers with petals colored in red, pink, white, green, and yellow, as well as smaller flower shapes and clusters of round, purple berries. Green and yellow leaves extend from the flowers, and additional floral and leaf motifs fill the corners and edges of the inner rectangle. The entire illustration is placed against a plain off-white background, with the number "44" printed in small numbers in the bottom left corner outside the border.
title: Plate 44: Painted Chest Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
